title: Nice Sheets
text: Nice Sheets. So pretty, so soft, so happy when I opened the package.  Two issues made me decide to return - one was that the title of the item clearly says 'deep pockets'.  Not the case, I have a Temperpedic and I also have lots of fitted sheets.  This set was about 7" deep and I need more like 10".  Also the sheet is sewn all the way around, possibly to help the sheet sit on the mattress but more like they are using a 108" wide fabric that is not going to completely fit a King size bed.  I have had this before and the seam drives me bananas at night.  Very sad to have to return, but very upset to waste several hours trying to make an informed decision and still not get what I need.
